ddl.name: run_permission_waits_unsent
ddl.where: "run_permission_waits"."denied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "run_permission_waits"."deny_sent_at" IS NULL

ddl.name: run_questions_unsent
ddl.where: "run_questions"."answer" IS NOT NULL AND "run_questions"."answer_sent_at" IS NULL

ddl.name: notification_events_target
ddl.value: ("run_id" IS NULL) <> ("runner_id" IS NULL) AND ("run_id" IS NULL) = ("workspace_id" IS NULL) AND ("run_id" IS NULL) = ("ticket_key" IS NULL)

ddl.name: run_permission_waits_sent_after_deny
ddl.value: "deny_sent_at" IS NULL OR "denied_at" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: run_questions_sent_after_answer
ddl.value: "answer_sent_at" IS NULL OR "answer" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: runs_worktree_kept_ended
ddl.value: ("worktree_kept" IS NULL AND "worktree_remove_requested_at" IS NULL) OR "state" = 'ended'

ddl.name: runs_active_started
ddl.value: "state" NOT IN ('running', 'waiting-for-input', 'paused', 'disconnected') OR "started_at" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: runs_paused_since_while_paused
ddl.value: ("state" <> 'paused' OR "paused_since" IS NOT NULL) AND ("paused_since" IS NULL OR "state" IN ('paused', 'disconnected'))

ddl.name: runs_started_has_runner_worktree
ddl.value: "started_at" IS NULL OR ("runner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "worktree_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "branch" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_ref" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: runs_not_started_ended
ddl.value: "state" <> 'ended' OR "started_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("agent_result" IN ('canceled', 'could-not-start') AND "pr_state" = 'none' AND "worktree_ref" IS NULL)

ddl.name: runs_could_not_start_not_started
ddl.value: "agent_result" IS NULL OR "agent_result" <> 'could-not-start' OR "started_at" IS NULL
